research_brief.purpose: Help firms read published website and intake benchmarks without mixing visits, conversions, qualified inquiries, consultations, and signed matters, and show how to build a first-party benchmark.
research_brief.audience: Managing partners, marketing leads, and intake managers at U.S. law firms planning 2027 reporting.
research_brief.data_period: Ruler Analytics 2026 benchmark; Clio 2024 secret-shopper study (press release October 7, 2024); Google Search Console documentation current October 2026
research_brief.scope_limitations: Desk research from public pages, corroborated through web search because the pages could not be opened directly. No proprietary Verdict Point data; no consented analytics sample was available, so the tracker plan for one is not met and is disclosed in the article.

claims.statement: Ruler Analytics reports a 7.9% legal conversion rate, 7.3% for organic search, and 56.3% of legal conversions by phone in 2026 data.
Clio's 2024 secret-shopper study of 500 firms found 30% hiring clarity, 14% pricing visibility, 40% phone pickup, and 33% email response.
Search Console performance reports show impressions, clicks, queries, and pages.
